record.name: Xero
record.one_liner: Cloud-based accounting software for small businesses, accountants, and bookkeepers.
record.access_note: Developers can sign up for a free account and get started with a free starter tier allowing up to 5 connections.
record.api_note: The API covers accounting, payroll, files, assets, and financial reports.
record.blocker_note: While a free starter tier exists for up to 5 connections, scaling beyond that requires paid subscription tiers.
